newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Fomulab knows no reason for share rise.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Fomulab knows no reason for share rise.

text.p: Computer software group Formulab Neuronetics Corp Ltd said in response to an Australian Stock Exchange (ASX) query on Monday that it knew of no reason for the recent rise in its share price.
The ASX had noted the rise in Formulab shares to 84 cents on Friday, November 8 from 59 cents on November 1.
At 11.35 a.m. (0035 GMT), Formulab shares were seven cents up at 87 cents, giving the company a market capitalisation of A$78.07 million.
